name: pi-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf
description: Pi package: AI agent controls a Kitesurf/surfbird browser engine over CDP — 28 surfbird_* tools with per-session isolation, semantic snapshots, screenshots/PDF. Shares the host-independent src/cdp core with the DSH and OpenCode plugins.
